source_intent.idea: Help a household notice pantry food that should be used soon without requiring a full inventory system.

provenance.source_note: The user's opening answer described a lightweight expiry reminder for household use.

phases.title: A usable pantry list
phases.goal: Let one household record dated pantry items and see what to use next from a local command.

provenance.source_note: Recommended as the smallest end-to-end milestone that satisfies the requested outcome without adding notifications.

stories.title: Store pantry items locally
stories.problem: The household needs a quick way to record an item, quantity, and best-before date without creating an account.

scope_in.text: Provide a local command that adds and lists pantry items.

provenance.source_note: The user chose a local command and explicitly rejected accounts for the first milestone.

scope_in.text: Persist data in a human-readable file under the user's chosen data directory.

scope_out.text: Shared household accounts and cloud synchronization.

acceptance_criteria.text: A user can add an item with name, quantity, and ISO date, then list the same values in a fresh process.

provenance.source_note: The user said a fresh-process round trip is the minimum proof that storage works.

acceptance_criteria.text: Automated tests cover valid input, an invalid date, and persistence across two command invocations.

provenance.source_note: Recommended from the user's request for repeatable command-level verification.
Recommended as the first atomic story needed by the usable milestone.

stories.title: Show what to use next
stories.problem: A stored list does not help the household act unless soonest-dated items are easy to find.

scope_in.text: Sort active items by best-before date and mark items due within seven days.

provenance.source_note: The user defined seven days as the useful planning window.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given fixed fixture dates, the command orders items deterministically and labels only items inside the seven-day window.

exit_criteria.text: A new user can install the command, record three items, and identify the soonest item from documented steps, with the command tests passing.
